data.long_meaning: From the Latin word ‘merces’, meaning ‘mercy’ or ‘reward’. In Christianity, the name Mercellia signifies God's boundless mercy and compassion towards His children. The name Mercellia carries the meaning “Merciful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Mercellia usually hope their child will grow to embody merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
